limits: Real source compiler, not prebuilt-program runtime. Only tested subset is claimed.
WASI target lacks C++ exceptions and threading support as documented upstream. Native graphics/OS APIs are outside this exercise runner.
Compiler binaries built with SIMD/bulk-memory; use modern browser with these WebAssembly features.
Official API eagerly constructs Clang/LLD plus a separate driver Clang instance; asset caching and ideally compiled module reuse are implementation work.
No PCH fetched. PCH is optional ~19MB extra, only compatible with upstream fixed C++20/-O2/-fno-exceptions flags.
Proof was localhost no-compression transfer, not measured GitHub Pages transfer. gzip bytes are offline recompression.
All 1024 current C++ curriculum lesson outputs matched under Clang20. This does not establish support for arbitrary C++20 code.
